review_comments: Previously, we will wait based on the estimated fsr enablement time. But if the restore failed, and restarted from scratch, we don't need to wait for such a long time because we can use the credit balance earned from last failed restore.
This change doesn't seem related to this PR at all. In general, I encourage you to make separate PRs for logically unrelated PRs.
